acf.speaker_position: Design Thinking Facilitator, UX Researcher at VirtusLab

blocks.html: Over 15 years of experience in leading teams and companies, working as a sales and media director in an international online marketing company, and as a CEO of a media house company for 6 years. Currently working as a UX Researcher and Design Thinking facilitator in IT sector. Since 2013 leading workshops, trainings and projects in Design Thinking & Service Design approach for such companies as Accenture, Link4, Orange, City of Warsaw and many more.
